disconnectum.chunky.warning: [Disconnectum] The server is overloaded (tick %s ms). Running Chunky now risks a "server disconnected" crash.
disconnectum.chunky.continue.hover: High risk. Keep Chunky running and stand still so no new chunks load. Warnings are muted for %s minutes.
disconnectum.chunky.stop.hover: Pause Chunky now. Disconnectum continues it when the server recovers, or use /disconnectum chunky continue.
disconnectum.command.continue: Chunky keeps running. Disconnectum stays quiet for %s minutes. Stand still to avoid loading more chunks.
disconnectum.command.stop: Paused %s Chunky task(s). Disconnectum continues them when the server recovers, or run /disconnectum chunky continue.
disconnectum.command.mode: Chunky mode is now %s (saved to the config file, no restart needed).
disconnectum.command.preset: Preset '%s' applied and saved. It takes effect immediately.
disconnectum.command.restart: Restart the game for the Chunky limit of %s simultaneous chunks to take effect.
disconnectum.command.failed: The Disconnectum config is not loaded yet; try again in a moment.
